result.title: Answer Correction with Verifiable Rewards: A Gemma-Family Study of Multi-View Driving QA
result.summary: Multi-camera driving question answering provides a discrete test of vision-language models, but post-training gains can reflect changed selected answers or improved answer extraction. We investigate this distinction within the Gemma model family using archived, task-linked WaymoQA evaluations. A zero-shot diagnostic on 5,519 test questions spans effective-small, mixture-of-experts, unified, and dense checkpoints, with serving differences disclosed rather than interpreted as architecture effects. The strongest controlled evidence is a matched-harness Gemma-4-12B base/GRPO pair: accuracy rises from 73.78% to 75.43%, a gain of 1.65 percentage points with a scene-cluster bootstrap interval of [+0.84, +2.41]. There are 215 improvements and 124 regressions; 213 improvements start from an extractable but incorrect base answer, and only two recover previously unextractable responses. Crossing correctness with extraction state shows why correct noncompliant outputs cannot be counted as prediction errors. Category counts reveal a critical safety asymmetry: routine perception gains (+5.93 pp) mask a regression in safety-critical hazard prediction (-1.82 pp), demonstrating that unweighted outcome rewards can trade off rare edge cases for aggregate accuracy. Reward saturation describes sampled training dynamics rather than an architectural ceiling. A separate archived Gemma-31B thinking comparison yields no detected average improvement, with uncertainty that does not establish equivalence. These results support a modest answer-selection gain for the recorded tuning configuration and a reproducible diagnostic accounting, without attributing corrected labels to specific grounding mechanisms or claiming superiority over matched supervised tuning.

AI.brief_summary: 在多相机驾驶问答（WaymoQA）上以 Gemma 系列检查点做零样本诊断，并用配对 harness 的 base/GRPO 对比，把后训练增益拆解为「答案选择改变」与「答案抽取改善」，同时报告感知类别提升掩盖安全关键危险预测下降的不对称性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「可抽取但错误」与「正确但不合规」的正确性×抽取状态交叉分析，可供核查 VLM 增益是否真正来自内部推理状态而非输出格式改善，无权重结果奖励掩盖稀有边缘案例也与 LVR 的奖励设计与评价混淆问题相关。
